sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: portable and shelf-stable. They are easy to keep around and need no preparation. Roasted crunch makes a small serving satisfying. The texture and flavour give this snack more staying power than many light packaged options. Still resembles the food it came from. Even roasted and salted, it remains closer to a whole food than most savoury snacks.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: The drawbacks next: the salt adds a sodium tradeoff. This exact entry has 428 milligrams of sodium per 100 grams. Handfuls add up quickly. The dense, snackable format makes casual portions easy to overshoot. Nut allergy rules them out for some people. That is a hard practical limit, not a tiny downside.
